label: D1 after an unrewarded trial, late in the episode (trial >= ~80)
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (100% of mass; never at GO or D2), and 99% of its mass is on D1 steps where the reward input is 0, i.e. the previous trial went unrewarded. It is also gated by position in the episode: it never fires before about trial 40, and its rate climbs steeply from trial 60 to trial 99 (5.3x lift in trials 90-99). It co-occurs with low model value (66% of mass in the lowest value bin). D1 & no reward alone gets recall 0.93 and mass recall 0.99 but precision 0.11. Adding ep_trial >= 80 gives P 0.43 / R 0.75 / F1 0.55 / mass recall 0.90 on dev. Using value < 6 instead gives about the same F1 (0.55). Requiring two unrewarded trials in a row, or a common previous transition, made it worse. Larger activations are more concentrated late in the episode (coverage of the top quartile is 0.98 versus 0.46 for the bottom quartile). It does not fire after rewarded trials. Precision is incomplete: many late, unrewarded D1 steps stay silent, so the predicate does not capture the exact gate. All variables used can be observed (reward input, episode clock).
